shape: someone who lives far away now, and the one small habit you both kept

slides.text: the stranger who jumped my car lives three states away now, but [[we still text 'made it']] every first frost.

caption:
she stood in the sleet with the red cables just to make sure the engine wouldn't die at the lights.
the stranger gave me her number at the kerb just to be certain i reached home, and never asked for anything back.
send this to the person who still tells you to text the second you pull into the drive.

#kindnessmatters #kindnessquotes #randomactsofkindness
alt: a short text post about a kind stranger who helped jump-start a car years ago and the winter text message habit they still keep.
